pageCopy.closingIntro: A brief introductory call gives us an opportunity to discuss what brings you here and explore whether my services are right for you.

servicePages.title: Individual Therapy
servicePages.description: Individual therapy with Dr Lauretta Ogbum — for people navigating anxiety, low mood, grief, trauma, stress, self-worth concerns and difficult life transitions.
servicePages.eyebrow: Understand yourself. Find a way forward.
heroCopy: Sometimes, the hardest part is understanding why you feel the way you do or why the same patterns keep appearing in your life.

content: Individual therapy offers a space to explore your experiences, emotions, relationships and personal challenges. Together, we work towards greater self-awareness, healthier responses and practical ways forward.
For people navigating anxiety, low mood, grief, trauma, stress, self-worth concerns and difficult life transitions.

servicePages.title: Couples Therapy
servicePages.description: Couples therapy with Dr Lauretta Ogbum — a structured, balanced space to explore recurring patterns, improve communication, address conflict and work towards a healthier relationship.
servicePages.eyebrow: For two people who still want to understand what is happening between them.
heroCopy: When communication breaks down and the same disagreements keep returning, it can become difficult to find your way back to one another.

content: Couples therapy provides a structured, balanced space to explore recurring patterns, improve communication, address conflict and work towards a healthier relationship.
My role is not to take sides or declare a winner. It is to help both partners understand what is happening and consider what needs to change.

servicePages.title: Before You Marry
servicePages.description: A five-session premarital counselling programme with Dr Lauretta Ogbum — money, family expectations, faith, values, communication, intimacy and how to navigate disagreements.
servicePages.eyebrow: Prepare for the marriage, not just the wedding.
heroCopy: Love matters, but so do the conversations that shape married life.

content: This five-session premarital counselling programme helps couples explore the issues that are often overlooked until they become sources of conflict: money, family expectations, faith, values, communication, intimacy and how to navigate disagreements.
The aim is not to promise a perfect marriage. It is to help you enter marriage with greater understanding, realistic expectations and practical tools for building a life together.

servicePages.title: The Annual Review
servicePages.description: A yearly check-in for your marriage with Dr Lauretta Ogbum — one structured session to review communication, connection, shared priorities and the year ahead.
servicePages.eyebrow: A yearly check-in for your marriage.
heroCopy: You do not have to wait until your marriage is in trouble before giving it attention.

content: The Annual Review offers couples an opportunity to pause, reflect on their relationship and consider what is working, what has changed and what needs more care.
Think of it as relationship maintenance: one structured session to review communication, connection, shared priorities and the year ahead.

servicePages.title: The Intensive
servicePages.description: Focused therapeutic work over one or two full days with Dr Lauretta Ogbum, for individuals or couples working on a specific concern.
servicePages.eyebrow: Focused therapeutic work, with more time to explore.
heroCopy: Sometimes, regular weekly sessions are difficult to accommodate. At other times, a particular concern needs a more concentrated period of attention.

content: The Intensive offers suitable individuals or couples an opportunity to work on a specific concern over one or two full days, with time for focused exploration, reflection and planning.
The format and suitability of an intensive are discussed in advance. It is not a substitute for emergency or crisis services.

servicePages.title: Diaspora Sessions
servicePages.description: Online therapeutic support with Dr Lauretta Ogbum for Nigerians living outside the country, with someone who understands the cultural context they may be navigating.
heroCopy: Living abroad can bring opportunities, but it can also introduce pressures around marriage, family expectations, cultural identity and belonging.

content: Diaspora Sessions offer online therapeutic support for Nigerians living outside the country who want to explore personal or relationship concerns with someone who understands the cultural context they may be navigating.
You should not have to spend the entire conversation explaining the background before you can begin discussing what matters to you.
